basic_authentication.description: Base 64 encoded string containing the `client_id` and `client_secret` values. The header value should be `Basic <base64(client_id:client_secret)>`.

scopes.activities:full: Create, read, update and delete activities and all files and filters. Also includes read access to activity fields and types
scopes.activities:read: Read activities, its fields and types; all files and filters
scopes.admin: Allows to do many things that an administrator can do in a Pipedrive company account - create, read, update and delete pipelines and its stages; deal, person and organization fields; activity types; users and permissions, etc. It also allows the app to create webhooks and fetch and delete webhooks that are created by the app
scopes.base: Read settings of the authorized user and currencies in an account
scopes.contact-fields:full: Create, read, update and delete person and organization fields
scopes.contacts:full: Create, read, update and delete persons and organizations and their followers; all notes, files, filters. Also grants read access to contacts-related fields
scopes.contacts:read: Read the data about persons and organizations, their related fields and followers; also all notes, files, filters
scopes.deal-fields:full: Create, read, update and delete deal fields
scopes.deals:full: Create, read, update and delete deals, its participants and followers; all files, notes, and filters. It also includes read access to deal fields, pipelines, stages, and statistics. Does not include access to activities (except the last and next activity related to a deal)
scopes.deals:read: Read most of the data about deals and related entities - deal fields, products, followers, participants; all notes, files, filters, pipelines, stages, and statistics. Does not include access to activities (except the last and next activity related to a deal)
scopes.goals:full: Create, read, update and delete goals
scopes.leads:full: Create, read, update and delete leads and lead labels
scopes.leads:read: Read data about leads and lead labels
scopes.mail:full: Read, update and delete mail threads. Also grants read access to mail messages
scopes.messengers-integration: Allows application to register as a messengers integration provider and allows them to deliver incoming messages and their statuses
scopes.phone-integration: Enables advanced call integration features like logging call duration and other metadata, and play call recordings inside Pipedrive
scopes.product-fields:full: Create, read, update and delete product fields
scopes.products:full: Create, read, update and delete products and its fields; add products to deals
scopes.products:read: Read products, its fields, files, followers and products connected to a deal
scopes.project-fields:full: Create, read, update and delete project fields
scopes.projects:full: Create, read, update and delete projects and its fields; add projects templates and project related tasks
scopes.projects:read: Read projects and its fields, tasks and project templates
scopes.recents:read: Read all recent changes occurred in an account. Includes data about activities, activity types, deals, files, filters, notes, persons, organizations, pipelines, stages, products and users
scopes.search:read: Search across the account for deals, persons, organizations, files and products, and see details about the returned results
scopes.users:read: Read data about users (people with access to a Pipedrive account), their permissions, roles and followers
scopes.video-calls: Allows application to register as a video call integration provider and create conference links

get.description: Returns data about all not archived deals.

parameters.description: If supplied, only deals matching the specified filter are returned
parameters.name: filter_id

parameters.description: Optional comma separated array of up to 100 entity ids to fetch. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored. If any of the requested entities do not exist or are not visible, they are not included in the response.
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: If supplied, only deals owned by the specified user are returned. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored.
parameters.name: owner_id

parameters.description: If supplied, only deals linked to the specified person are returned. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored.
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.description: If supplied, only deals linked to the specified organization are returned. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored.
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.description: If supplied, only deals in the specified pipeline are returned. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored.
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.description: If supplied, only deals in the specified stage are returned. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored.
parameters.name: stage_id

parameters.description: Only fetch deals with a specific status. If omitted, all not deleted deals are returned. If set to deleted, deals that have been deleted up to 30 days ago will be included. Multiple statuses can be included as a comma separated array. If filter_id is provided, this is ignored.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: If set, only deals with an `update_time` later than or equal to this time are returned. In RFC3339 format, e.g. 2025-01-01T10:20:00Z.
parameters.name: updated_since

parameters.description: If set, only deals with an `update_time` earlier than this time are returned. In RFC3339 format, e.g. 2025-01-01T10:20:00Z.
parameters.name: updated_until

parameters.description: The field to sort by. Supported fields: `id`, `update_time`, `add_time`.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: The sorting direction. Supported values: `asc`, `desc`.
parameters.name: sort_direction

parameters.description: Optional comma separated string array of additional fields to include
parameters.name: include_fields

parameters.description:
Optional comma separated string array of custom fields keys to include. If you are only interested in a particular set of custom fields, please use this parameter for faster results and smaller response.
A maximum of 15 keys is allowed.
parameters.name: custom_fields

parameters.description: When provided with a 'true' value, single option and multiple option custom fields values contain objects in the form of '{ id: number, label: string }' instead of plain id
parameters.name: include_option_labels

parameters.description: When provided with 'true' value, response will include an array of label objects in the form of '{ id: number, label: string }'
parameters.name: include_labels

parameters.description: For pagination, the limit of entries to be returned. If not provided, 100 items will be returned. Please note that a maximum value of 500 is allowed.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: For pagination, the marker (an opaque string value) representing the first item on the next page
parameters.name: cursor

success.description: If the response is successful or not

additional_data.description: The additional data of the list

next_cursor.description: The first item on the next page. The value of the `next_cursor` field will be `null` if you have reached the end of the dataset and there’s no more pages to be returned.

channel.description: The ID of your Marketing channel this Deal was created from. Recognized Marketing channels can be configured in your Company settings.

channel_id.description: The optional ID to further distinguish the Marketing channel.

close_time.description: The date and time of closing the deal

currency.description: The currency associated with the deal

is_archived.description: Whether the deal is archived or not

is_deleted.description: Whether the deal is deleted or not

label_ids.description: The IDs of labels assigned to the deal

lost_reason.description: The reason for losing the deal

lost_time.description: The date and time of changing the deal status as lost

Only available in Growth and above plans

Null if there are no products attached to the deal

person_id.description: The ID of the person linked to the deal

pipeline_id.description: The ID of the pipeline associated with the deal

probability.description: The success probability percentage of the deal

source_lead_id.description: The ID of the lead if the deal was converted from a lead. Only included when requested via include_fields parameter.

stage_change_time.description: The last updated date and time of the deal stage

won_time.description: The date and time of changing the deal status as won
